# SAIFU — AI Video Production & Application Development

> AI comic series, short dramas, videos and ads: commissions and project inquiries welcome. AI video tools and custom application development are also available.

SAIFU (赛蚨里奇) is the brand of 北京赛蚨里奇科技有限公司, Beijing Saifuliqi Technology Co., Ltd. The official company website is https://saifuliqi.com/.

The company accepts commissions for AI comic series, short dramas, creative videos and ads. It also develops AI video generation and editing tools and purpose-built applications. Its stated work combines capability selection, product design, software development and workflow integration. Production and development scope, costs and timelines are discussed for the actual brief; this website does not publish a self-serve subscription or a public video-generation API.

## Production services

- [AI comic series production](https://saifuliqi.com/en/services/ai-comic-series): Comic-style narrative videos and episodic stories.
- [AI short drama production](https://saifuliqi.com/en/services/ai-short-dramas): Short dramas and narrative films.
- [AI video production](https://saifuliqi.com/en/services/ai-video-production): Brand content, product introductions and creative films.
- [AI ad production](https://saifuliqi.com/en/services/ai-ad-production): Ads, brand commercials and product promotion videos.
- [中文：AI 漫剧制作](https://saifuliqi.com/services/ai-comic-series)
- [中文：AI 短剧制作](https://saifuliqi.com/services/ai-short-dramas)

- [中文：AI 广告制作](https://saifuliqi.com/services/ai-ad-production)
